thread:
maya: Quick sync — tying the webinar sessions to canonical landing pages and clean redirects. Want to avoid keyword cannibalization and make sure the post-webinar bench narrative maps to one canonical URL. :eyes:
raj: +1. do we have a single target page per session or one master webinar hub?
lina: Proposal: one hub (hub.redwood.ai/webinar/21-mar) + per-session anchors that canonical -> hub. Keeps link equity centralized.
owen: anchors are fine but we need canonical tags on the old session pages we control (legacy blog posts). Otherwise GA attribution gets messy.
priya: Can we do 301s for legacy blog -> hub for pages with <300 visits last 90d, and soft canonical for higher traffic?
sam: Agree with priya. Also we should update internal links from product pages to point to the hub not legacy posts. I'll make a link-sweep plan.
maya: Good. Can someone draft exact redirect rules? I put a rough mapping in the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-webinar-redirect-map
raj: I'll drop a minimal nginx style snippet we can hand to infra.
seo-bot: crawl report: 78 legacy pages referencing webinar content, 12 pages with conflicting canonicals, 4 302s to fix.
raj: ```
# nginx redirect examples
location = /old-blog/webinar-session-a {
  return 301 https://hub.redwood.ai/webinar/21-mar#session-a;
}
location ~ ^/old-blog/webinar-(.*)$ {
  return 301 https://hub.redwood.ai/webinar/21-mar#${1};
}
```
lina: Also need JSON-LD FAQ schema for the hub and each session anchor block on the hub. That helps SERP real estate for webinar queries.
priya: I'll sketch one example, put in CMS field "faq_schema" so it renders on the hub page.
priya: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"FAQPage","mainEntity":[{"@type":"Question","name":"What topics are covered?","acceptedAnswer":{"@type":"Answer","text":"Latency, cost, model routing and rollout best practices."}}]}
```
maya: Nice. Ops checklist: 1) implement 301s for low-traffic legacy pages, 2) canonicalize high-traffic pages to hub, 3) update internal links on product/docs/promo pages, 4) add JSON-LD FAQ + speakable for the hub, 5) test redirects and check Search Console for index issues, 6) add UTM template for webinar CTAs.
sam: I'll run the internal link sweep on staging tomorrow morning, marking PRs for each repo.
owen: QA items: verify canonical headers, verify 301 behavior with curl, check GA session source after redirect (compare last 7 days). Example curl test: `curl -I https://redwood.ai/old-blog/webinar-session-a`
raj: Who owns Search Console notifications? maya?
maya: I'll own Search Console and post-launch indexing monitoring. Please ping #devex for any infra deploy windows.
priya: For messaging iteration — we should include the primary keyword cluster in the H1 and first paragraph, but vary H2s per session anchor so we don't repeat exact phrases.
seo-bot: quick note: ensure hreflang not set on hub pages unless we have localized content. Found 3 hubs with en-US hreflang incorrectly set.
maya: Cool. Target timeline: redirects + canonical updates by EOD Thu, schema and internal link PRs by Mon. Can everyone confirm?
raj: Confirmed, will open redirect PRs today.
lina: Confirmed for schema work.
sam: Confirmed for link sweep.
priya: Confirmed on messaging tweaks.
seo-bot: postponed crawl scheduled for 48h after deploy.
maya: Thanks all — I'll assemble the prelaunch checklist and post it here. :thumbsup:
